floor_anchor.meaning: The fight floor must stay visible near the bottom of the 224 px Mega Drive viewport.
floor_anchor.runtime_rule: Camera Y must clamp so the floor anchor remains readable; free vertical explorer motion is not proof of fighting camera behavior.

fighter_focus_contract.focus_y_rule: focus_y = clamp(camera_start_y + round(max(0, airborne_y_delta) * verticalfollow), boundhigh, boundlow)

implemented_rules: camera_x follows midpoint of two virtual fighter points
fighter fixture starts at world x 314 and 454 around focus x 384
fighter horizontal separation is capped at 224 px
camera_y remains floor locked at 256 until airborne delta exceeds 100 px
super jump fixture applies verticalfollow 1/2 and clamps camera_y 0..256
scene-entry input cooldown prevents menu A from triggering an evidence jump
BG_B streams the far plane at 43/100 horizontal and 285/1000 vertical camera delta
BG_A streams mid/floor rows with 71/100 and 1/1 horizontal bands
BG_A and BG_B HSCROLL_LINE preserve sub-tile parallax; BG_A adds water reflection offset gradient
BG_B occlusion culling skips far-plane cells hidden by fully opaque BG_A tiles
remaining_gaps: fixture points are not final fighter entities
no runtime camera telemetry stream is attached
foreground priority/sprite-graft behavior is not validated against real fighter sprites
line-scroll parallax has not been captured with scripted moving-camera evidence

rejected_as_evidence: autopan sweep as proof of fighting camera
camera that hides the floor at start
